name: compile_empty
doc:
**(B)** 空程序编译为空图。原为 `theorem compile_empty … := rfl`，平凡。
保留作为接口锚点。
stmt: theorem compile_empty : compile_program ([] : lvProgram) = ([] : CompilerConstraintGraph)
proof: rfl

name: compile_constraint_ps_irrelevant
doc:
**(A) 编译结果与点列表参数无关**。
原文 `compile_constraint_ps_irrelevant`（`funext` + `rfl`）。
**这条定理本身就是 §7 降级 D5 的证据**：源程序的点信息**完全没有进入编译产物**，
所以「编译」实质上是**逐语句的无状态重写**，而非真正的 lowering。
stmt:
theorem compile_constraint_ps_irrelevant (ps1 ps2 : List lvPoint) :
    compile_constraint ps1 = compile_constraint ps2
proof:
by
  funext c; rfl

name: compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant
doc: **(A) 语句编译与点列表无关**（对 `compile_constraint_ps_irrelevant` 的分派）。
stmt:
theorem compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant (ps1 ps2 : List lvPoint) (st : lvStmt) :
    compile_stmt st ps1 = compile_stmt st ps2
proof:
by
  unfold compile_stmt
  cases st with
  | point p => rfl
  | constraint c => rw [compile_constraint_ps_irrelevant ps1 ps2]
  | prove => rfl
  | normalize => rfl

name: compile_program_go_ps_irrelevant
doc: **(A) 程序编译与初始点列表无关**：结构归纳，非平凡。
stmt:
theorem compile_program_go_ps_irrelevant (ps1 ps2 : List lvPoint) (prog : lvProgram) :
    compile_program_go ps1 prog = compile_program_go ps2 prog
proof:
by
  induction prog generalizing ps1 ps2 with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons st sts ih =>
      cases st with
      | point p =>
          show compile_stmt (.point p) ps1 ++ compile_program_go (p :: ps1) sts =
               compile_stmt (.point p) ps2 ++ compile_program_go (p :: ps2) sts
          rw [compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant ps1 ps2, ih (p :: ps1) (p :: ps2)]
      | constraint c =>
          show compile_stmt (.constraint c) ps1 ++ compile_program_go ps1 sts =
               compile_stmt (.constraint c) ps2 ++ compile_program_go ps2 sts
          rw [compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant ps1 ps2, ih ps1 ps2]
      | prove =>
          show compile_stmt .prove ps1 ++ compile_program_go ps1 sts =
               compile_stmt .prove ps2 ++ compile_program_go ps2 sts
          rw [compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant ps1 ps2, ih ps1 ps2]
      | normalize =>
          show compile_stmt .normalize ps1 ++ compile_program_go ps1 sts =
               compile_stmt .normalize ps2 ++ compile_program_go ps2 sts
          rw [compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant ps1 ps2, ih ps1 ps2]

name: compile_program_go_append
doc: **(A) `compile_program_go` 对拼接的分配律**（带初始点列表参数）。
stmt:
theorem compile_program_go_append (ps : List lvPoint) (p1 p2 : lvProgram) :
    compile_program_go ps (p1 ++ p2) =
      compile_program_go ps p1 ++ compile_program_go ps p2
proof:
by
  induction p1 generalizing ps with
  | nil => simp [compile_program_go]
  | cons st rest ih =>
      cases st with
      | point p =>
          show compile_stmt (.point p) ps ++ compile_program_go (p :: ps) (rest ++ p2) =
               (compile_stmt (.point p) ps ++ compile_program_go (p :: ps) rest) ++
                 compile_program_go ps p2
          rw [ih (p :: ps), compile_program_go_ps_irrelevant (p :: ps) ps p2]
          simp [List.append_assoc]
      | constraint c =>
          show compile_stmt (.constraint c) ps ++ compile_program_go ps (rest ++ p2) =
               (compile_stmt (.constraint c) ps ++ compile_program_go ps rest) ++
                 compile_program_go ps p2
          rw [ih ps]
          simp [List.append_assoc]
      | prove =>
          show compile_stmt .prove ps ++ compile_program_go ps (rest ++ p2) =
               (compile_stmt .prove ps ++ compile_program_go ps rest) ++ compile_program_go ps p2
          rw [ih ps]
          simp [List.append_assoc]
      | normalize =>
          show compile_stmt .normalize ps ++ compile_program_go ps (rest ++ p2) =
               (compile_stmt .normalize ps ++ compile_program_go ps rest) ++
                 compile_program_go ps p2
          rw [ih ps]
          simp [List.append_assoc]

name: compile_program_append
doc: **(A) 程序拼接的编译分配律**：`compile (p1 ++ p2) = compile p1 ++ compile p2`。
stmt:
theorem compile_program_append (p1 p2 : lvProgram) :
    compile_program (p1 ++ p2) = compile_program p1 ++ compile_program p2
proof:
by
  unfold compile_program
  exact compile_program_go_append [] p1 p2

name: ir_expr_vars
doc: **(A) IR 表达式变量集**。
stmt:
def ir_expr_vars : IRExpr → List String
  | .var v => [v]
  | .const _ => []
  | .add e1 e2 => ir_expr_vars e1 ++ ir_expr_vars e2
  | .sub e1 e2 => ir_expr_vars e1 ++ ir_expr_vars e2
  | .mul e1 e2 => ir_expr_vars e1 ++ ir_expr_vars e2
  | .div e1 e2 => ir_expr_vars e1 ++ ir_expr_vars e2
  | .sqrt e => ir_expr_vars e

name: ir_vars
doc: **(A) IR 约束变量集**。
stmt:
def ir_vars : IRConstraint → List String
  | .distance a b d => [a, b] ++ ir_expr_vars d
  | .collinear a b c => [a, b, c]
  | .perpendicular a b c d => [a, b, c, d]
  | .parallel a b c d => [a, b, c, d]
  | .angle a b c d theta => [a, b, c, d] ++ ir_expr_vars theta
  | .midpoint m a b => [m, a, b]
  | .rightAngle a b c => [a, b, c]
  | .equalLength a b c d => [a, b, c, d]
  | .equalAngle a b c d e f => [a, b, c, d, e, f]
  | .radius c a r => [c, a] ++ ir_expr_vars r
  | .tangent ctr pt la lb => [ctr, pt, la, lb]
  | .ratioDivision p a b r => [p, a, b] ++ ir_expr_vars r
  | .eq_expr e1 e2 => ir_expr_vars e1 ++ ir_expr_vars e2
  | .lt_expr e1 e2 => ir_expr_vars e1 ++ ir_expr_vars e2
  | .gt_expr e1 e2 => ir_expr_vars e1 ++ ir_expr_vars e2

name: eval_expr_depends_on_vars
doc: **(A) 表达式求值只依赖其变量集**：结构归纳，非平凡。原 `eval_expr_depends_on_vars`。
stmt:
theorem eval_expr_depends_on_vars (e : IRExpr) (env1 env2 : String → ℝ × ℝ)
    (h : ∀ v, v ∈ ir_expr_vars e → env1 v = env2 v) :
    eval_expr env1 e = eval_expr env2 e
proof:
by
  induction e with
  | var v => rw [eval_expr, h v (by simp [ir_expr_vars]), eval_expr]
  | const c => simp [eval_expr]
  | add e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
      have h1 := ih1 (fun v hv => h v (by simp [ir_expr_vars, hv]))
      have h2 := ih2 (fun v hv => h v (by simp [ir_expr_vars, hv]))
      simp [eval_expr, h1, h2]
  | sub e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
      have h1 := ih1 (fun v hv => h v (by simp [ir_expr_vars, hv]))
      have h2 := ih2 (fun v hv => h v (by simp [ir_expr_vars, hv]))
      simp [eval_expr, h1, h2]
  | mul e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
      have h1 := ih1 (fun v hv => h v (by simp [ir_expr_vars, hv]))
      have h2 := ih2 (fun v hv => h v (by simp [ir_expr_vars, hv]))
      simp [eval_expr, h1, h2]
  | div e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
      have h1 := ih1 (fun v hv => h v (by simp [ir_expr_vars, hv]))
      have h2 := ih2 (fun v hv => h v (by simp [ir_expr_vars, hv]))
      simp [eval_expr, h1, h2]
  | sqrt e ih =>
      have h1 := ih (fun v hv => h v (by simp [ir_expr_vars, hv]))
      simp [eval_expr, h1]

name: compile_program_go_contains
doc:
**(A) 编译产物的来源追踪**：`compile_program_go` 的每个输出都来自源程序某条约束的编译。
结构归纳（4 个语句 case），是真结果。
stmt:
theorem compile_program_go_contains (pts : List lvPoint) (prog : lvProgram) :
    ∀ ir ∈ compile_program_go pts prog,
      ∃ c ∈ constraints_of_program prog, compile_constraint [] c = some ir
proof:
by
  induction prog generalizing pts with
  | nil => intro ir hir; simp [compile_program_go] at hir
  | cons st sts ih =>
      intro ir hir
      cases st with
      | point p =>
          simp only [compile_program_go, compile_stmt, List.nil_append] at hir
          rcases ih (p :: pts) ir hir with ⟨c, hc, hcc⟩
          exact ⟨c, by rw [constraints_of_program_cons_point]; exact hc, hcc⟩
      | constraint c =>
          simp only [compile_program_go, compile_stmt, List.mem_append] at hir
          rcases hir with hir | hir
          ·                                   
            cases hc0 : compile_constraint pts c with
            | none => simp [hc0] at hir
            | some ir' =>
                have hir' : ir = ir' := by simpa [hc0] using hir
                subst hir'

                  rw [congrFun (compile_constraint_ps_irrelevant [] pts) c]; exact hc0⟩

          simp only [compile_program_go, compile_stmt, List.nil_append] at hir
          rcases ih pts ir hir with ⟨c, hc, hcc⟩
          exact ⟨c, by rw [constraints_of_program_cons_prove]; exact hc, hcc⟩

name: variables_disjoint
doc: **(A) 两程序变量集不相交**。

proof:
(∀ v, v ∈ vars_of_program p1 → v ∉ vars_of_program p2) ∧

name: compiled_ir_vars_subset_args
doc:
**(A) 编译产物的变量都来自源约束的 args**：12 个 kind × arity 穷举，非平凡。

证明策略：按 `compile_constraint [] c` 的**结果形状**分派。
每个命中分支中 `ir` 的形状由 `h` 唯一确定（`injection` + `subst`），于是 `ir_vars ir`
显式可算，`v ∈ ir_vars ir` 直接给出 `v ∈ c.args`（`args` 的形状也被同一分支固定）。

**注意 修法记录（F3）**：原实现用 `first | (cases h; simp_all [ir_vars, ir_expr_vars]) | (simp [compile_constraint] at h)`，
与 `compile_constraint_degenerately_satisfied` **同一根因**（`cases h` 对局部假设 `ir` 朝错误方向消去 +
`first` 静默接受"成功但不闭合"分支），报 12 条 `unsolved goals`。
现改为 `injection h with h'` + `subst h'` 后 `simp only [ir_vars, ir_expr_vars]` **显式闭合**。
stmt:
theorem compiled_ir_vars_subset_args (c : lvConstraint) (ir : IRConstraint)
    (h : compile_constraint [] c = some ir) (v : String) (hv : v ∈ ir_vars ir) :
    v ∈ c.args
proof:
by
                                                        
  obtain ⟨_, kind, args⟩ := c
  cases kind with
  | collinear =>
    cases args with
    | nil => simp [compile_constraint] at h
    | cons a1 r1 => cases r1 with
      | nil => simp [compile_constraint] at h
      | cons a2 r2 => cases r2 with
        | nil => simp [compile_constraint] at h
        | cons a3 r3 => cases r3 with
          | nil =>
            · simp only [compile_constraint] at h
              injection h with h'
              subst h'
              simp_all [ir_vars, ir_expr_vars]
          | cons _ _ => simp [compile_constraint] at h
  | parallel =>
    cases args with
    | nil => simp [compile_constraint] at h
    | cons a1 r1 => cases r1 with
      | nil => simp [compile_constraint] at h
      | cons a2 r2 => cases r2 with
        | nil => simp [compile_constraint] at h
        | cons a3 r3 => cases r3 with
          | nil => simp [compile_constraint] at h
          | cons a4 r4 => cases r4 with
            | nil =>
              · simp only [compile_constraint] at h
                injection h with h'
                subst h'
                simp_all [ir_vars, ir_expr_vars]
            | cons _ _ => simp [compile_constraint] at h
  | perpendicular =>
    cases args with
    | nil => simp [compile_constraint] at h
    | cons a1 r1 => cases r1 with
      | nil => simp [compile_constraint] at h
      | cons a2 r2 => cases r2 with
        | nil => simp [compile_constraint] at h
        | cons a3 r3

name: constraint_args_mem_vars
doc: **(A) 约束参数都在程序的变量集中**。
stmt:
theorem constraint_args_mem_vars (p : lvProgram) (c : lvConstraint)
    (hc : c ∈ constraints_of_program p) (v : String) (hv : v ∈ c.args) :
    v ∈ vars_of_program p
proof:
by
  unfold vars_of_program
  rw [List.mem_append]; right
  unfold constraints_of_program at hc
  rcases List.mem_flatMap.mp hc with ⟨st, hst, hmem⟩
  cases st with
  | constraint c' =>
      have hceq : c = c' := by simpa using hmem
      subst c'
      exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨.constraint c, hst, hv⟩
  | point _ => simp at hmem
  | prove => simp at hmem
  | normalize => simp at hmem

name: compile_program_vars_subset
doc: **(A) 编译产生的 IR 约束只引用源程序中对应的变量**。
stmt:
theorem compile_program_vars_subset (p : lvProgram) (ir : IRConstraint)
    (h : ir ∈ compile_program p) (v : String) (hv : v ∈ ir_vars ir) :
    v ∈ vars_of_program p
proof:
by
  rcases compile_program_contains_compiled_constraints p ir h with ⟨c, hc, hcc⟩
  exact constraint_args_mem_vars p c hc v (compiled_ir_vars_subset_args c ir hcc v hv)

name: compile_append_satisfiable
doc:
**(A) 变量不相交时编译结果可拼合**：
这是本包**唯一的「模块化编译正确性」真结果**——
`compile p1` 与 `compile p2` 各自可满足 ⟹ `compile (p1 ++ p2)` 可满足。
证明用 `compile_program_append` + `ir_sem_depends_on_vars` 构造「分片环境」。
stmt:
theorem compile_append_satisfiable (p1 p2 : lvProgram) (h_disjoint : variables_disjoint p1 p2)
    (h1 : graph_satisfiable (compile_program p1))
    (h2 : graph_satisfiable (compile_program p2)) :
    graph_satisfiable (compile_program (p1 ++ p2))
proof:
by
  rw [compile_program_append]
  rcases h1 with ⟨env1, hsat1⟩
  rcases h2 with ⟨env2, hsat2⟩
  let env : String → ℝ × ℝ := fun v => if v ∈ vars_of_program p1 then env1 v else env2 v
  refine ⟨env, ?_⟩
  intro ir hir
  rw [List.mem_append] at hir
  rcases hir with hir | hir
  · have hsame : ∀ v, v ∈ ir_vars ir → env v = env1 v := by
      intro v hv
      have hv1 := compile_program_vars_subset p1 ir hir v hv
      simp [env, hv1]
    exact (ir_sem_depends_on_vars ir env env1 hsame).mpr (hsat1 ir hir)
  · have hsame : ∀ v, v ∈ ir_vars ir → env v = env2 v := by
      intro v hv
      have hv2 := compile_program_vars_subset p2 ir hir v hv
      have hvne : v ∉ vars_of_program p1 := h_disjoint.2 v hv2
      simp [env, hvne]
    exact (ir_sem_depends_on_vars ir env env2 hsame).mpr (hsat2 ir hir)


end Lattice.Lv00.Compiler
